name: Clarity in Qualia
source:
Alyx is a young man who has allowed his mother to dictate every aspect of his life for as long as he can remember. As a result, Alyx is currently in further education studying subjects that he has no interest in and dating a girl who he doesn't have feelings for.  He has known for a while that his romantic urges tend to veer towards other males but is afraid of actually mentioning it to his mother for fear of upsetting her. In fact, Alyx refuses to even accept himself, preferring instead to just let life pass him by. Despite being fairly miserable, Alyx is empathetic to the point that he would prefer to suffer in silence than face the possibility of hurting others. His only solace lies in a chat group he came across online, where he's able to be a truer version of himself around the other members of the group, Alvy, Sio, Elil, and Kagan.

One day, Alyx is involved in an accident that puts him in a coma. As he dreams away in hospital, a mysterious figure called Merrik visits him, claiming to be his spirit guide. Merrik warns Alyx that if he continues to refuse to accept himself then he will never wake up. All hope is not lost, as Merrik offers Alyx another opportunity to live, with the condition that he makes an effort to be true to himself. There is one condition, however, Alyx must prove to Merrik that he has the ability to change within just 3 days, or face death after all.

With the help of his online friends, can Alyx learn to love himself for who he really is on the inside? The outcome is entirely up to you! Make choices and help Alyx on his journey of self-discovery, deepen friendship with his online companions, and possibly even find true love :3
[From [url=https://ikarikali.itch.io/clarity-in-qualia] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
艾莉克斯是一个年轻人，从他记事起，他就让母亲决定他生活的方方面面。结果，艾莉克斯目前正在继续深造，学习他不感兴趣的科目，并与一个他没有感情的女孩约会。一段时间以来，他已经知道自己的浪漫冲动往往会转向其他男性，但他不敢向母亲提起，以免惹恼她。事实上，艾莉克斯甚至拒绝接受自己，宁愿让生活从他身边溜走。尽管艾莉克斯相当痛苦，但他很有同理心，他宁愿默默承受痛苦，也不愿面对伤害他人的可能性。他唯一的安慰来自于他在网上遇到的一个聊天群，在那里他能够在该群的其他成员Alvy、Sio、Elil和Kagan周围展现出更真实的自己。

有一天，艾莉克斯遭遇了一场事故，导致他陷入昏迷。当他在医院做梦时，一个名叫梅里克的神秘人物拜访了他，自称是他的精神向导。梅里克警告艾莉克斯，如果他继续拒绝接受自己，那么他将永远不会醒来。所有的希望都没有消失，梅里克为艾莉克斯提供了另一个活下去的机会，条件是他必须努力忠于自己。不过有一个条件，艾莉克斯必须向梅里克证明自己有能力在短短三天内改变现状，否则最终将面临死亡。

在网上朋友的帮助下，艾莉克斯能学会爱自己的内心吗？结果完全取决于你！做出选择并帮助Alyx踏上自我发现之旅，加深与在线同伴的友谊，甚至可能找到真爱 :3
